proposals.evidence: Full mānuṣa article explicitly gives Gujarati māṇas man and Marathi māṇūs man, alongside Old Gujarati māṇisa and Old Marwari mā̃ṇasa. Bhilali/Rathawi mānas and Khandesi mānos man match this western family, retaining nasal and vowel notation as qualifications. The parallel manuṣya article was inspected separately; local IA transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: mānos.
